title: Smores with Yummi Pops Nacho and Sea Salt
instructions: Step 2. Cut the chicken breasts into ¾-inch strips.
Step 3. Place the Ranchitas in a bowl and crush them using a mortar or food processor.
Step 4. In another bowl, beat the egg and add the milk.
Step 5. Dip each chicken strip into the egg mixture, then coat with the crushed Ranchitas.
Step 6. Place the strips on a baking tray.
Step 7. Lightly brush each strip with vegetable oil.
Step 8. Bake for 15 to 17 minutes or until the chicken is fully cooked.
Step 9. Serve with Mazola Lemon Mayonnaise.
